unsupported: Core processes include welding, forming, and fitting of steel and aluminum, with the team handling everything from one-off prototypes to small production runs out of their Ballard Way facility.
Customers span the marine sector—including private boat owners, commercial vessel operators, and offshore platforms—as well as residential clients seeking custom metal fabrication for homes.
The shop’s “BMF way” centers on owning every weld and fabrication, ensuring each piece meets the longevity expectations of harsh marine environments.
